transcript.answer: I can only partly answer this. The triage loop is confirmed to run on a repository whose settings say nothing about it. Lore's notes say settings.issue_triage.enabled is "ON when absent", and only an explicit off makes the sweep skip the repo. I could not confirm the default for the other loops. The implementation loop is probably off unless the repository switches it on: the notes talk about "re-enabling" implementation_loop for one watched run, and the Loops tab gives it a per-repository toggle. I did not find that stated outright. The code review, auto merge, spec upkeep and digest loops were described as still to come, so I found nothing on their defaults. The defaults are decided in loopEnabled(key, settings) in libs/shared/src/domain/loops, which I could not read.

judgements.reason: The answer correctly says triage is on by omission and leans toward the implementation loop being off, but it gives no defaults for spec upkeep, spec tickets, code review, auto-merge or digest, and it contradicts nothing.
